label: DotH (Horizontal Line, Dooms Anchor)
author: Created by: Sausage Roll and Edited by NAUR Staff Team

steps.label: Pre-position relative to WAR
steps.note:
THIS STRAT HAS NO ROLE/STATIC POSITIONS.
Party can change line order as they please.

Simplest mechanic permutations are reserved for the 4 players at the two ends of the line. 

(In this case.. NIN, GNB, SCH, & BRD)

steps.label: Doom spawns
steps.note:
Check yo'self:
- Dooms step relative North
- Non-dooms step relative South

(This makes finding your spot very easy)

steps.label: Positions
steps.note: Watch the cast bars on Enemy List and prepare for Twister.

steps.label: Twisters/Dives/Lightnings
steps.note:
Doom players move towards WAR right after lightning hit.

Non-doom players move around to prep for next dynamo.

steps.label: Move with the Lightning aoes
steps.note:
Doom players move towards WAR right after lightning hit.

Non-doom players move around to prep for next dynamo.

steps.label: Check Gazes
steps.note: You should be looking for/already know where the 2 Gazes are right about now!

steps.label: Pre-position for PS2
steps.note:
Dooms anchor (E, SE, SW, W)
- O markers are baited to the 2 Dooms furthest from each other

Non-Dooms adjust to opposite of their partners

steps.label: Dooms Anchor
steps.note:
Dooms anchor (E, SE, SW, W)
- O markers are baited to the 2 Dooms furthest from each other

Non-Dooms adjust to opposite of their partners

steps.label: PS2 Order
steps.note:
Dooms anchor (E, SE, SW, W)

Non-Dooms adjust to opposite of their partners

steps.label: Knockback + Gazes
steps.note: Make sure to move towards wall after knockback if chain doesn't break.

steps.label: Meteors
steps.note:
Caster LB the 3 North Meteors. 
Kill other meteors manually.
